subject: prd/argus-ledger-lint
statement: Every per-DINV defect fixture (edited `A-n`, edited/second/renumbered/deleted `E-n`, unattributed entry as applicable, cited derived block, dangling `delivery:` anchor) is red at exactly its arm; legal appends + legal `E-n` citations are green; and the cross-document arm is green on the repo's own citation-bearing prose (this PRD, the frozen record, argus-artifacts) whose literal-`<slug>` illustrations are not in-scope citations (FR-9)
fit_criterion: the fixture corpus (incl. the own-corpus non-regression fixture) + first-run defect report
